name: shuten
description: Two plugins that cut an agent's excess text: CCShut — comments in the code (against context rot), Shut — chatter in the chat (token savings). All four shapes in plain English.

plugins.name: ccshut
plugins.description: Against context rot: a comment is written only if it stays true after the code around it is rewritten and a senior working in the repo could not recover it from the code itself. One line ending in the date, under 5% of a file's lines; stale and decorative comments are deleted.

plugins.name: shut
plugins.description: Token savings: drops progress reports, tool-call announcements and the rest of the text that changes nothing. Four shapes, all plain English — a step label of at most 4 words, plus a question, a warning and a final answer of at most 8 lines. The code and the result of the work are left untouched.
